verdict.rationale: Teams' first-party platform docs describe building agents and bots that users can chat with in Teams and that can initiate and participate in conversations, so the core idea of an AI agent taking part in conversations is a product capability. However, the evidence never explicitly documents adding the agent as a member of a channel or having it respond only when @mentioned; the bot-participation snippet is truncated, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of installing an agent into a channel, explicit @mention-triggered responses in channels, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can add an AI agent as a member of a channel that participates in conversations when mentioned
